jobs.title: Principal iToF & Camera Systems Engineer
jobs.description: Requires 5+ years of experience. 5+ years of industry experience as a camera systems engineer, optical systems engineer, or 3D sensing engineer Deep understanding of Indirect Time-of-Flight (iToF) sensor architectures, including continuous-wave modulation, demodulation pixels, and active illumination concepts Strong proficiency in Python, MATLAB, or C/C++ for scientific computing, numerical analysis, pixel performance modeling, or depth-mapping software
